ch6-curriculum-coverage.en: Let's check how much of the curriculum has been covered.
Open Planning and Delivery, then choose Curriculum Coverage.
Choose a class and a subject. The tiles show the total, taught and tested topics.
Use the coverage filter to show only the topics that aren't covered yet.
Switch to Timeline to see the topics spread across the year.
ch6-question-bank.en: Let's add a question to the question bank.
Open Content Creation, then choose Question Bank.
Choose the class, subject, book and chapter. Then choose the type, type your question, and tick the topic it tests.
Save, and the question appears in the bank.
Choose the class and subject in the filters, and your new question shows up in the list.
ch6-question-paper-builder-and-question-: Let's build a question paper from your question bank.
Open Content Creation, then choose Paper Builder.
Choose the class and subject, then finish the title. It starts from your class and subject.
Go to Paper Structure. Sections are optional. A marks warning appears, so press Continue, then choose Type manually.
Type the question, then add it to the paper.
Open the draft to save it. All your papers are listed under Question Papers.
Your paper is now saved as a draft.
ch6-step-1-define-grade-scale.en: Let's set up the grade scale.
Open Academics, then choose Grade Scale.
To add a higher grade, first lower the top of grade A. Press Edit, set Max to 89.99, and press Update.
Enter the grade label, the minimum and maximum percentage, and the grade point.
Press Create, and the new grade appears in the list.
ch6-step-2-create-exam-types.en: Now let's create the exam types.
Open Academics, then choose Exam Types.
Type the name, and set the weight: how much this exam counts toward the final result.
Tick Final exam only for exams that decide promotion. Leave it off for a unit test.
Press Create, and the new exam type appears in the list.
ch6-step-3-create-an-exam.en: Choose the academic year, the term and the exam type.
Enter the dates, then press Next to choose the classes.
Select the class, then continue through the date sheet to the preview.
Check the preview, then press Create Exam.
A new exam starts as Scheduled. You move it forward as marks are entered and results are published.
ch6-step-4-enter-marks.en: Open Academics, then choose Marks Entry.
Choose the exam, then the class and the subject.
All the students of that class load automatically.
Type each student's marks. The maximum marks are checked for you.
Press Save All Marks. You can come back and edit until the results are published.
ch6-step-5-view-publish-results.en: Let's view the results, and announce them.
Choose the class and the exam to see the computed results, with marks and grades.
Review the results for accuracy before you announce them.
To make the results visible, open Exams and expand the exam group.
Press Announce Results, then confirm. Students and parents can now see the results.
ch6-step-6-generate-report-cards.en: Open Academics, then choose Report Cards.
Choose a class, then pick a student.
Filter by session and exams if you like.
The preview shows the exam results, grades and GPA.
Press Download PDF to get a printable report card.
ch6-step-7-monthly-skill-behaviour-asses: Let's record the monthly skill and behaviour assessments.
Choose the class and month, and the roster loads every student.
Rate a skill and a behaviour for the first student, then write a teacher remark.
Press Save Month to save the whole class at once.
ch6-weighted-average-configuration.en: Let's turn on the weighted average.
Open Settings and go to the School Profile tab.
Scroll to Examination Settings. Weighted Average is off, so simple averaging is used.
Click the switch to turn Weighted Average on. Each exam type now counts by its weight.
Then check the weight of each exam type on the Exam Types page.
ch7-bulk-operations.en: Open Finance, then choose Collect Payments.
Tick the header box to select every student, or tick students one by one.
At the bottom bar, choose the account that receives the money.
Press Pay Full, and every selected student is marked fully paid at once. The bar also lets you delete the selected records.
ch7-creating-individual-fee-records.en: Let's create a single fee record.
Open Finance, then choose Collect Payments.
Select the class, then search for the student and pick them from the list.
Choose the fee category. The amount fills in from the fee structure.
If the student has already paid, enter the amount paid. Then press Create. The window closes and the new record appears in the table.
ch7-fee-overview.en: Let's get an overview of your school's fees.
Open Finance, then choose Fee Overview. It shows the status of your fees at a glance.
Choose Monthly or Annual view, then the month and year.
Category-wise Collection shows how much of each fee category has been collected.
Collection Progress shows how much of the total due is paid.
Use Collect Payments to record payments, or Fee Setup to change the fee amounts.
